text:
ryan (PM): quick sync 5min. EnterpriseBank is asking for a middle ground product: predictable capacity for two heavy routes, purchasable priority-minutes, and an SLA-credit mechanic for a 4-week pilot. no Dedicated. can we outline contract shape + accept criteria?
lina (AE): customer will commit to a monthly spend band but won't take reserved GPUs. must-have: per-route predictability and a clear remediation if p99 spikes.
todd (Pricing): product levers to consider: 1) per-route soft buckets billed per-minute, 2) priority-minute packs, 3) surge-window blocks. commercial mix = commit + premium on priority minutes. need cost delta from eng to size uplift.
omar (Eng): technical reality: we can add a runtime priority path + per-route token buckets. true isolation (no noisy neighbor) requires Dedicated. KV pinning for hot prefixes is doable but has memory and eviction tradeoffs.
marta (Legal): if we promise credits, we need: measurement method, credit cap (percentage of monthly commit), carve-outs for maintenance/force majeure, and an EU data-residency addendum (customer flagged EU).
ryan (PM): proposed field pilot "midtier-qos beta" (4 weeks): - per-route soft QPS buckets (configurable) - priority-minute billing tracked per-route - automatic fallback to baseline model variant when tokens exhausted - SLA credit formula: sum(minutes where p99 > target) * credit_unit, capped at 20% of monthly commit. thoughts?
lina (AE): sales 👍. customer ok with non-binding pilot SLA if SLOs are explicit and instrumented. they also want route-level gating (only specified route_ids can use priority).
todd (Pricing): +1. acceptance criteria from pricing: baseline unit-econ, expected priority-minute burn rates, recommended per-1k-minute price bands, and a hard monthly cap to prevent runaway spend.
omar (Eng): eng acceptance criteria: 1) runtime supports priority flag + per-route token bucket, 2) KV pinning MVP with documented memory limits, 3) feature-flag rollout + canary. estimate: 10 working days spike + 2 sprints to pilot build.
infra-bot: reminder scheduled: "midtier-qos pilot kickoff" 2026-05-14 16:00 UTC
marta (Legal): I'll draft a pilot addendum with credit cap = min(monthly commit, 20%) and standard carve-outs. will include EU addendum language.
ryan (PM): provisional pricing placeholders (todd please confirm): +15% token uplift for priority minutes, +30% for exclusive surge windows, and minute-pack discounts for bulk. placeholders until eng cost delta.
todd (Pricing): noted. will produce conservative/typical/optimistic scenarios once eng provides cost delta. include recommended emergency shutoff and abuse detection.
lina (AE): customer also wants the admin UI to limit which route_ids are allowed priority. confirm feasibility?
omar (Eng): feasible. enforcement by route_id + token bucket server-side. API param + console toggle. if over-limit return 429 or deduct from minute-pack if present.
ryan (PM): pilot success metrics & GA gates suggestion: - commercial: pilot net uplift >= 10% of MRR net of incremental cost - performance: p99 delta on baseline routes <= 15% - ops: support tickets related to priority <= threshold TBD - observability: per-route p50/p95/p99 and priority-minute burn dashboard
todd (Pricing): add economic safety gate: expected gross margin on priority consumption must meet target threshold.
marta (Legal): GA expansion with public SLA requires legal/liability review. pilot T&C will be limited and timeboxed.
ryan (PM): action items:
- omar: spike + short design doc for token buckets and KV pinning (10d)
- todd: pricing scenarios and unit-econ (5d)
- marta: pilot addendum + EU clause (3d)
- lina: get signed pilot acceptance + route_id list (2d)
- ryan: pilot dashboard mock + acceptance checklist (3d)
omar (Eng): I'll post spike notes and perf numbers in #eng-runtime when ready.
todd (Pricing): I'll draft a pricing slide deck and share assumptions.
marta (Legal): I'll circulate a compact pilot clause for quick sign-off.
ryan (PM): thanks team. reconvene after spike. :thumbsup:
